body:
Completed the bounded documentation rework on PR #3213 (`agy2/engineering-audit-report`) in `/home/joe/ai/aida-worktrees/agy2-engineering-audit` for `TASK-2709` (`TASK-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-662`).

1. **Pushed Head SHA & PR Title:**
   - **Pushed SHA:** `87a64bfab3b3b970be6b67e870bf41ef98e1fda9` (normal non-force push on `agy2/engineering-audit-report`)
   - **PR #3213 Title Updated:** `[AI:antigravity] docs(showcase): publish interactive DORA, GitClear & LinearB engineering audit (TASK-2709)` (removed historical `TASK-HOME-130` trailer; added `<!-- trace:TASK-2709 | ai:antigravity -->` to both new HTML files; did not reopen or claim completion on `TASK-2542`).
   - **Four-file publication scope preserved:** `docs/showcase/engineering-audit.html`, `docs/showcase/index.html`, `docs/showcase/README.md`, and `docs/reports/2026-11-01-aida-industry-engineering-audit.html`.

2. **Finding 1 Resolution (DORA Scorecard & Repository Proxy vs. Deployment Metrics):**
   - Updated the DORA Four-Key Metrics Scorecard, KPI #6 (`Commit Revert Ratio`), Executive Scorecard row 5 (`Trunk Commit Revert Ratio (Repo Proxy)`), and all corresponding glossary tooltips in both `docs/showcase/engineering-audit.html` and `docs/reports/2026-11-01-aida-industry-engineering-audit.html`.
   - Linked primary DORA definitions (`https://dora.dev/guides/dora-metrics/`) and added a dedicated column separating **Actual Production Deployment Metric (`Unknown` — no production deployment/incident telemetry linked in repo)** from **Measured Repository Proxy (`main`)**:
     - **Deployment Frequency:** Production = `Unknown`; Repo integration proxy = `12.8–14.4 PRs/day` (`26.6–27.9 commits/day` onto `main`).
     - **Change Lead Time:** Production = `Unknown`; Repo commit-to-merge proxy = `14.5m median` non-zero CI ship settlement (`~40m–2.2h` w/ review).
     - **Change Failure Rate (CFR):** Production = `Unknown`; Repo commit revert proxy (`3a`) = `0.17%` (`7` git reverts / `4,190` commits, explicitly labeled not deployment CFR); Repo `fix:`/`BUG-` commit share (`3b`) = `31.6%` (`1,326 / 4,190`, explicitly labeled commit-intent proxy combining proactive audit/review follow-up capture + fixes).
     - **Failed Deployment Recovery Time (MTTR):** Production = `Unknown`; Repo proxy = `Unmeasured` (defects remediated via forward-fix `BUG-` slices and `doctor --heal`, with no deployment incident/recovery dataset).

3. **Finding 2 Resolution (Illustrative Simulator, Removal of Top-0.1% Claims, Methodology & Primary Sources):**
   - **Simulator (`updateSimulator` & UI):** Renamed to `Illustrative Architecture & Batch-Size What-If Explorer` with badge `Illustrative What-If (Assumed Weights)`, added an explicit methodology disclaimer on the card and updated the JS comment in `updateSimulator()` stating that weights (`10.5`, `8.8`, `11.2`, `6.4`, `11.5`, `4.2`) are illustrative heuristic assumptions anchored to measured repository baselines with no fitted regression calibration or predictive/causal validity.
   - **Removed all `top-0.1%` / `Top 0.1%` claims** across both files.
   - **Added Methodology & Primary Sources Block (Section 01):** Documents pinned SHA `6a3f67671a974703590efde5ae2a323f3f7471fa`, exact collection commands (`tokei --output json`, `sqlite3 .codegraph/codegraph.db`, `git log main --oneline / --shortstat / --numstat --since="30 days ago"`, `.aida/review-verdicts/**/*.json`), primary references (`https://dora.dev/guides/dora-metrics/`, `https://linearb.io/blog/git-analytics`, SmartBear/Cisco Cohen et al. & GitClear 2024), explains that `27.7%` `<21d` churn is a file-level commit-window proxy (`git log --numstat`) rather than line-blame survival, marks 8-dev squad rows as illustrative scaling assumptions (`*`), and qualifies co-occurrence between `>400-LoC` batches, hub files, and churn as an architectural hypothesis rather than proved causation.

4. **Local Gate Validation (all PASS on `87a64bfab3b3b970be6b67e870bf41ef98e1fda9`):**
   - `python3 docs/showcase/build.py --check` -> PASS (exit 0)
   - `python3 -m unittest tests/test_showcase_publish.py` -> PASS (7/7 tests)
   - Inline JS `node --check` on both `docs/showcase/engineering-audit.html` and `docs/reports/2026-11-01-aida-industry-engineering-audit.html` -> PASS
   - `git diff --check` -> PASS (clean)
